content.comment_body: Is it possible to disable buttons on the [product_name] operator device, except for the function keys F1-F4 which are needed for the program? The device is connected to a [product_name] controller via Ethernet. I've read through other topics but couldn't find an answer. I want to prevent operators from accidentally entering the menu. Thanks!

No, this feature isn't available. The key controls are managed by the operating system of the [product_name] controller, and users do not have the ability to disable them. To clarify your issue: while using the [product_name] controller, you can switch between administrator and user modes with a password, but you cannot selectively disable keys.

Hi, with a [product_name] controller, you can switch to operator mode, which allows the operator access only to: F1-F4 keys, C-Keys (if programmed), and parameter adjustments in message texts if these aren't protected. All other settings are restricted. To get full access, you must enter the administrator password. The default password is [product_name]. Hope this clarifies things.

analysis.insight_summary: Users aim to improve operator safety by limiting access to specific buttons on the [product_name] operator device when used with the [product_name] controller. However, the available system settings do not provide a way to selectively disable buttons beyond switching between user and administrator modes with a password, leaving concerns about accidental menu entry unresolved.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a way to block all display buttons except F1-F4 on the [product_name] operator device, so critical program functions remain accessible but operators are prevented from entering unwanted menus.
